title: How to collect a urine sample from a baby
what: The test needs clean urine from your baby. It is collected in a special baby urine bag or a sterile jar.
why: At a checkup, for a fever with no clear cause, if your baby cries when peeing, or after an illness.
duration: collecting takes from a few minutes to an hour; results usually come in 1 day
tell_doctor: If your baby has diaper rash or irritated skin
If the test is for a culture. Then collection must be extra clean

prepare.title: Urine bag
prepare.text: Buy a sterile baby urine bag at a pharmacy. There are separate ones for boys and girls. Also get a sterile container.

prepare.title: Hygiene
prepare.text: Before collecting, wash your baby with warm water and soap from front to back, and pat dry.

prepare.title: Timing
prepare.text: Morning urine is best. It usually needs to reach the lab within 1 to 2 hours.

steps: Wash your baby and pat the skin dry
Peel the backing off the urine bag
Stick it on: for a boy, with the penis inside; for a girl, over the labia
You can put a diaper on top, but not tight
As soon as your baby pees, remove the bag and pour the urine into the container
Close it tightly and take it to the lab
feel: Your baby may fuss because of the sticky edge
Remove the bag gently so the skin is not irritated
after: Results usually come the next day
Your pediatrician will explain the results

faq.q: Can I squeeze urine out of a diaper or take it from a potty?
faq.a: No. That urine is not clean, and the test will not be accurate. Use a urine bag or a clean jar.

faq.q: My baby is not peeing. What should I do?
faq.a: Give your baby a drink or a feed. Sometimes warm water or gently stroking the belly helps.

reminders.text: Your baby's urine test is tomorrow. Get a sterile urine bag and container ready.
